summary: Validated the Emergent Google sign-in ADD-ONLY integration + full regression on existing email/password/anonymous auth. Backend: 6/6 tests passed (new /api/auth/google 401 on invalid/400 on empty, picture field on all user responses, login/me unchanged, anon session grants 3 credits, fresh register auto-login grants 3 credits). Frontend: Google button renders with correct label 'Continua con Google' and data-testid=auth-google above email form; clicking it redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fpre-launch-verify-2.preview.emergentagent.com%2F (origin+'/', NO hardcoded fallback / localhost). Regression: anon credits badge '3 Crediti' shows on first load; mario@studio.it / secret123 login works (header shows 'Mario' + 8 Crediti); logout reverts header to 'Accedi' and shows 'Disconnesso' toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1461 lines — approaching the 'split into modules' threshold; consider splitting auth/payments/analysis into submodules in a later refactor (non-blocking).
/api/auth/google rate limit is per-IP 20/hour which is reasonable; email-based rate limiting could be added later to mitigate account enumeration via valid-session floods (minor).
seed_data_creation: Register path creates a fresh TEST user (lowercased by backend) with 3 credits to verify auto-login + picture field; no persistent seed required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google OAuth end-to-end round-trip (real Google account) CANNOT be automated — only the redirect initiation + backend session-data exchange error path (401 on invalid session_id) are automatable. Real round-trip must be done manually by the user. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_google_auth.py and are safe to re-run as regression. Note: backend lowercases emails on register — tests must use lowercase for assertions.
